info.title: Zobba owned HTTP interface
info.description: Service health, current scoped identity, durable Task commands, immutable scoped evidence and exact operation decisions under standing Permissions. Provider acceptance and completed effects are distinct; no live connector, model, computer or audit execution is implied.

secret.description: Private random 32-byte base64url invitation value. POST bodies only; never a query, log or projection.

id.description: Immutable logical material identity; never a credential or download capability.

ledger_id.description: Non-secret source ledger identity bound when this attempt was admitted.

methodology_binding_id.description: Exact immutable binding effective when this attempt was admitted.

source_id.description: Non-secret logical source identity; never an endpoint URL or capability.

attachments.description: Sorted by unique attachment ID; complete immutable material identities.

destination.description: Exact logical destination, never a caller-selected URL or credential.

expires_at.description: Exact positive Unix seconds represented as decimal text.

material.description: Exact reviewed material, at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes.

recipients.description: Sorted unique logical recipient identities; order is canonical and substitutions refuse.

event_cursor.description: Decimal commit-ordered cursor; represented as text to preserve integer precision.

status.description: Admission is durable. Applied and observed cessation are separate event/snapshot facts.

cursor.description: Decimal Received or Applied cursor, no greater than the snapshot watermark.

events.description: Invalidation facts; obtain a new consistent snapshot to replace current state.

next_cursor.description: Last returned cursor, or unchanged input. Never advances over omitted facts.

resync_required.description:
Gap, cursor ahead of server, or backlog exceeding 1000: refresh the snapshot.
Events is empty and next_cursor unchanged; do not infer progress from watermark.

watermark.description: Requested fixed through cursor, including Applied facts only through that cursor.

applied_cursor.description: Applied means retained plain text reached a work boundary, not model understanding.

author_label.description: Current public label of the retained author; role changes do not erase authorship.

oneOf.description: Exact optional Create or Guide context retained for durable command recovery.

cycle_id.description: Resulting cycle. Continue preserves its old addressed cycle separately below.

before_cursor.description: Exclusive Received cursor for the preceding history page at this watermark.

oneOf.description: Latest current-scope Received or Applied fact, independent of message and Task pages.

messages.description: Latest 100 accepted commands in ascending Received order; not the complete history.

next_task_cursor.description: Continue through GET tasks?after_task_id; those pages are fresh current reads.

tasks.description: First 100 current Tasks ordered by ID; open any known ID independently.

watermark.description: All included Task state and receipt facts come from the same statement as this cursor.

key.description: Exact persisted decision key, scoped to the recorded actor and engagement.

recorded_at.description: Server recording time, positive Unix seconds as decimal text.

client_name.description: 1–200 Unicode scalars; no C0/C1 controls or leading/trailing Unicode White_Space.

engagement_name.description: 1–200 Unicode scalars; no C0/C1 controls or leading/trailing Unicode White_Space.

organisation_name.description: 1–200 Unicode scalars; no C0/C1 controls or leading/trailing Unicode White_Space.

oneOf.description: Continue after this complete scope tuple; null means no further current assignments.

EvidenceBinary.description: Raw original bytes, not a JSON array or a base64-encoded string.

storage_configured.description: Storage configuration is present; this does not assert bucket readiness.

reserved_at.description: Server-recorded reservation time, Unix seconds; registration completes acquisition.

version.description: Immutable storage version independently confirmed by a bounded pinned read.

EvidenceSourceAssertions.description: Each populated value is the acquisition actor's assertion; null means unknown.

source_version.description: Asserted source-system version, separate from the measured storage version.

roles.description: Unique roles fixed for this invitation; acceptance cannot broaden them.

secret.description: Private random 32-byte base64url invitation value. POST bodies only; never a query, log or projection.

MembershipAssignmentChange.description:
One assignment selected in a membership Save. Renewal is an explicit choice
for this scope; omitting it has the same meaning as false for exact retries.

renew.description:
True explicitly renews this scope if its stored assignment expired or
became inactive. A future active expiry is preserved. Remove mode must use false.

MembershipAssignmentCursor.description: Exclusive cursor containing a client identifier, a dot, then an engagement identifier.

MembershipIdentifier.description: A bounded ASCII application identifier; also used for idempotency keys.

MembershipInvitationSecret.description: Private random 32-byte base64url capability. POST bodies only; never query strings or logs.

assignments_complete.description: False requires the paged assignment endpoint; the preview must not be used as a replacement set.

assignments_count.description: Effective assignments in this organisation, including any beyond the bounded preview.

MembershipRecipientEmail.description: ASCII address with a local part of 1–64 characters and DNS-style domain labels. Preserve local-part case; lowercase the domain.

MembershipRole.description: Application roles are fixed; provider roles never grant application authority.

MembershipVersion.description: Canonical nonnegative decimal through 9223372036854775807; no signs or leading zeros.

available_at.description: Availability in Unix seconds, independent of business applicability dates.

candidate_version_ids.description: Exact version candidates retained for subsequent Task context discovery.

context_command_id.description: Exact Guide command supplying this context, retained through later bindings.

execution_epoch.description: Task execution epoch from which this exact binding applies.

potentially_material.description: Unknown or changed semantics are potentially material.

criteria.description: Absent fields inherit. Empty arrays cannot erase inherited mandatory controls.

neutral_source_version_ids.description:
Up to 128 saved neutral contributors plus the built-in fallback, joined to
requirement field and template source IDs.

criteria.description: Resolved inherited values can combine up to 128 saved versions.

engagements.description: Assignment metadata for current Admins; grants no access to audit work.

period_start.description: Inclusive business date, YYYY-MM-DD. Both period dates are required together.

MethodologyTemplateProse.description: Preserved Unicode prose containing at least one character outside Unicode White_Space; at most 2000 Unicode characters. LF, CR and tab are allowed; all other control characters are refused. Indentation, line endings, trailing whitespace and U+FEFF are preserved exactly.

MethodologyText.description: Nonempty, already-trimmed Unicode text without control characters; at most 2000 Unicode characters.

fact.description: A recorded source fact. Unknown or Accepted proves neither completion nor absence.

allow.description: False records an exact refusal; true cannot override a hard prohibition.

expires_at.description: Decision expiry cannot exceed request expiry. Positive Unix seconds as decimal text.

request.description: The complete request read and reviewed by this actor. Any material change refuses.

attempt_next_cursor.description: Exclusive attempt ID; each history collection has its own continuation.

decision_next_cursor.description: Exclusive decision ID; null means this fresh page exhausted that collection.

decisions.description: Immutable decisions in ID order, including the persisted decider and exact expiry.

observation_next_cursor.description: Exclusive observation ID. Restart from the first page to discover new records.

actor_id.description: Immutable producing actor; the reading or deciding actor does not replace it.

execution_epoch.description: Immutable producing Task epoch; methodology history identifies its exact criteria.

methodology_binding_id.description: Exact immutable Task methodology binding used by the producer.

state.description: Provider acceptance is distinct from a completed effect; possible dispatch remains uncertain.

next_cursor.description: Exclusive operation ID; null means no further rows for this exact Task.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds through 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z; null explicitly clears membership expiry.

roles.description: Unique application roles; an active membership must have at least one.

expected_revision.description: Canonical decimal revision, bounded by 9223372036854775806 so a successor fits.

reason.description: Server-owned explanation, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
Server-owned explanation, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

content.description:
Exact UTF-8 resource bytes: 32 KiB per resource and 128 KiB in aggregate.
Nonempty under Unicode White_Space; only LF, CR and tab controls allowed.
U+FEFF, indentation and line endings are preserved; scripts remain inert.

Exact retained text, at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes. Required only for Create and Guide.
Must contain non-whitespace; control characters other than LF, CR and tab are refused.

oneOf.description:
Optional methodology context for Create or Guide. Guide supplies a full
replacement; omitted/null leaves the current context unchanged. Create
does not require a methodology picker before accepting the Task.

key.description: Author and composite scope bind this key. Identical retries return the original receipt.

task_id.description: Required together with cycle_id except for Create, which requires both absent/null.

kind.description: Fixed event category, including received and applied. No content or capability is included.

next_cursor.description: Last returned cursor, or the input cursor on an empty page. Poll again from this value.

accountable_actor.description: Accountable human identity, distinct from worker ownership.

accountable_label.description: Current public label of the accountable human, independent of recent message pages.

state.description: Desired control/work state; Paused/Stopped require separate observed cessation.

working_brief.description: Retained plain text; no model understanding or audit result is asserted.

next_cursor.description: Pass this Task ID as after_task_id; null means no further current Tasks.

tasks.description: Current projection ordered by Task ID; open known IDs independently of this page.

login_binding.name: __Host-zobba-login
login_binding.description: One-use current login browser binding; Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/

server_session.name: __Host-zobba-session
server_session.description: Opaque server session; Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/; browser managed, never an OIDC provider token
